svg.title: Model your UI with Ash: a screen is a resource, and each session gets its own row.
svg.desc: The InboxScreen resource holds one row per browser session. Each row is rendered through the :view calculation into its own browser. A click in a browser comes back as an action on the row. The screen reads the Message domain resource through a relationship, and Message notifications cause a reload.
svg.text: Model each screen as a resource and give every session its own row. No more parallel vocabularies for the business domain and your UI.
click → :select runs on that session's row

g.text: View = a calculation of the row
Event = an action on the row
